Email._comment: Leave Host empty to disable email entirely - the app works fine without it. Free options: Gmail smtp.gmail.com:587 with an App Password, Outlook smtp-mail.outlook.com:587, or Zoho smtp.zoho.com:587. Real credentials go in dotnet user-secrets (local dev) or environment variables (production) - NEVER in this file, since it's committed to git. Username must be the FULL email address (e.g. fashionfix.notifications@gmail.com) - NOT the app password; Password is the app password.

CourierGuy._comment: The Courier Guy / Shiplogic. Leave ApiKey empty to disable courier features entirely - the app works fine without it (booking buttons just report 'not configured'). Sandbox base URL is https://api.shiplogic.com (register free at https://sandbox.shiplogic.com/register, then generate a key under Integrations > API Keys). Production uses https://api.portal.thecourierguy.co.za with a separate production key from support@shiplogic.com. The ApiKey goes in dotnet user-secrets or an env var - NEVER in this file.

GoogleMaps._comment: Browser key for address autocomplete, restricted to your domains. Leave ApiKey empty to disable autocomplete; forms still work. Set the real value with dotnet user-secrets or the GoogleMaps__ApiKey env var - NEVER in this file.

AddressAutocomplete._comment: Address search provider. Leave GeoapifyApiKey empty to disable. Set the real key with: dotnet user-secrets set "AddressAutocomplete:GeoapifyApiKey" "..." (production: env var AddressAutocomplete__GeoapifyApiKey) - NEVER in this file.
